generation.scope: At slopes (3,2), the entire geometric length-four defect on the two fixed elliptic curves consists of sixteen admissible points, eight modulo exchange. Four nonsplit points missed over F_101 extend to explicit opposite-determinant sections at every ordinary slope; they have opposite rank sixteen and dimensions at least 36,68 in lengths four and five at every start.

proof_review.scope: Verified four-character rank bounds, geometric support including nonsplit and boundary points, exchange pairs and localization.

mathematical_computation.scope: Recomputed maximal minors over Q, projected by resultants, saturated residuals with rational Groebner bases, and tested all endpoint completions. Four additional sections have exact generic path ranks 36 and 68.

tex.engine: LuaHBTeX; no overfull boxes, missing glyphs or undefined references

open_mathematics: Test whether the exact sixteen-point quartic defect support persists at generic slopes, by bounding the divisors of the normalized rank minors before specialization; also look for length-five or higher obstructions off this support.
